output.summary: An article dated Sept 23 reports an OCBC ATM, internet and mobile banking disruption with data protected. Its CEO quote looks dated, and nothing corroborates it.

citations.quote: All customer data was protected with “appropriate security measures” during today’s disruption of automated-teller machine, Internet and mobile-phone banking services
OCBC declined 1.5 per cent or S$0.49 to S$31.65.
